0022600150.text: Sacramento (0-5) visits Memphis (5-0) for its sixth game of the season, having lost all five games so far, including all three on the road, while the Grizzlies have won all five and are second in the Western Conference. The Kings are missing Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), and Memphis is without Quinten Post (ankle), Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness), and Ty Jerome (back soreness), all listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. Memphis beat Sacramento 123-112 in Sacramento on October 25, 2026, the only meeting this season, and the Grizzlies also won three of four meetings in the 2025-26 season.
